final_response_fingerprint.details: crates/jcode-tui/src/tui/app/board.rs: parse `/board [target]`, `/board login [name]`, `/board logout [name]`. login/logout: name may be account (server) or world; no name in a world dir => that world's account (today's behavior); no name outside a world (no cwd or UnknownWorld only) => every account from board_accounts() lacking a token, started one after another via commands_mcp::start_login; logout with no name outside world => list accounts and require a name. Use McpConfig::load_for_dir(None) when no repo. Keep check_board_server, remote-only, no static Authorization checks per server. Usage text updated.

/board with no world (no cwd or UnknownWorld) builds an all-accounts runtime: per account list_teams, per team read issues with Discovered scope, but a team matching a configured binding uses its Configured scope (no duplicates). Columns grouped by state kind (backlog, unstarted, started, completed, canceled; unknown -> Other). Cards labeled with team key, plus account when >1 account. Header 'All accounts · read-only'. A failing/unauthorized account shows a notice 'X: run /board login X' and does not hide others. Other refusals (identity, ambiguous, Brown/Azure) still shown as today.

/board <target> uses resolve_world, never the cwd. spawn_board_move: re-verify a Configured scope with no canonical_root via resolve_world(world[/team[/project]]); with a root keep resolve_board(&cwd). Discovered never offers a confirmation (overlay read_only).

Run cargo test -p jcode-tui board, cargo test -p jcode-base board, scripts/dev_cargo.sh build --profile selfdev -p jcode --bin jcode. Commit owned paths only.
